# StoneBuild Games

> StoneBuild Games is an independent, remote game development studio that builds 3D, 2D and multiplayer games for Android, iOS and PC with Unity, Unreal Engine and Godot. It develops games for clients from concept to store launch, and is building its first original title for Google Play.

The site is a small set of static HTML pages. No login or API is needed.

## Pages

- [Home](https://stonebuildgames.com/): Studio overview, services summary and a playable mini-game
- [Services](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/): Six game development services, engagement models, process and FAQ
- [Full-cycle development](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/full-cycle-game-development/)
- [3D games](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/3d-game-development/)
- [Mobile and casual games](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/mobile-game-development/)
- [Multiplayer and backend](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/multiplayer-game-development/)
- [Game art and animation](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/game-art-and-animation/)
- [Porting, QA and publishing](https://stonebuildgames.com/services/porting-qa-publishing/)
- [About](https://stonebuildgames.com/about/): Why the studio exists, values, how it works, tools
- [Games](https://stonebuildgames.com/games/): Titles published by the studio with platforms, status and store links. The first title is in production and has no store link yet
- [Contact](https://stonebuildgames.com/contact/): Project inquiry form and email
- [Privacy policy](https://stonebuildgames.com/privacy-policy/): Covers the website and all StoneBuild games, including data deletion requests
- [Terms and conditions](https://stonebuildgames.com/terms/): Terms for the games and the website

## Contact

- Email: support@stonebuildgames.com (replies within two business days)

- [Sitemap](https://stonebuildgames.com/sitemap.xml): All indexable URLs
